pages.text: [#](53341a)Touching an inhabited mirror carries you into that mirror's own **9 x 9 x 9** reflected room. The dark world is a full 256 blocks high: fifteen chambers are claimed vertically at each place before the glass seeks the next place in its outward spiral.[#]()
pages.title: The Mirror World

pages.text: [#](53341a)Different source mirrors always own different rooms.[#]()

[#](53341a)The unbreakable inner mirror returns you beside its exact source in any dimension, even before the room is cleared. Break the source and its link remains in the dropped mirror; a companion outside may carry that exit anchor, or place it again to reconnect the inner glass.[#]()
pages.title: The Linked Glass

pages.text: [#](53341a)Your Reflection wears your skin, armor, strongest hotbar weapon, and enchantments as an image. Every true Reflection yields exactly one **Demon Heart**, but copied gear is never loot.[#]()
pages.title: The Reflection

pages.text: [#](53341a)The source mirror clears only when no Reflection remains alive in its chamber; after that, the guardian does not return.[#]()

[#](53341a)Ordinary mirrors can bridge to an opposite-facing mirror within 31 blocks, carrying living creatures and dropped items. A cleared pair outside this world can also bridge vertically between same-facing mirrors.[#]()
pages.title: Walking Lesser Glass

pages.text: [#](53341a)Inside the Mirror World, an unpaired mirror may spend **3,000 altar power** to move a traveller one to nine blocks forward. Only players cross dimensions; an ordinary inner mirror never opens another room.[#]()
[#](53341a)Say **mirror mirror send me home** to return to your recorded inner mirror; that mercy rests for five minutes after use.[#]()
pages.title: Words for the Lost

pages.text: [#](53341a)Say **mirror mirror i give up** to abandon the glass for a valid bed or the Overworld spawn; that deeper surrender rests for one hour. Your ordinary linked return route also survives a disconnect.[#]()

[#](53341a)The floating face called by an ordinary uncleared mirror is a brief divination apparition, not the room guardian. A Duplication Grenade creates a passive ten-second copy that draws hostile attention without attacking.[#]()
pages.title: Faces and False Reflections

pages.text: [#](53341a)Neither false image can clear a room or yield guardian treasure.[#]()
